Definition: from G2596 and G5343; to flee down (away):--flee.
BiblicalUsage: Paul and Barnabas fled to Lystra and Derbe when they knew the plot against them, and we are told to flee for refuge to lay hold on the hope set before us.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fleeing is not cowardice when the refuge is God Himself.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
